source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 9–17 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 256 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Use relatives for the women’s broader brothers claim but retain father’s brothers specifically; name Joshua as the implied grantor in context.
Render rightward as south in this geographical description while retaining the reference to En-tappuah’s inhabitants.
Unfold the compressed enclave description without merging Ephraim’s southern towns with Manasseh’s northern boundary.
Retain the shift from towns to inhabitants and the difficult three-heights phrase; explain its uncertain relation to the six named places in a note.
Preserve coercion and the emphatic failure to expel rather than presenting forced labor as complete conquest.
Keep forest clearing and expulsion as distinct actions and preserve the concessive force despite the enemy’s equipment and strength.
